name: MPN Research Foundation — MPN Challenge™ & Translational Grants
equity_dilution: 0% (Non-dilutive translational grant; aligned with Canadian MPNRF global alliance)
focus_areas: MPN disease progression (ET/PV -> MF -> blast phase), selective clonal eradication, stromal fibrosis biology, and progression biomarkers.

name: Blood Cancer United (formerly Leukemia & Lymphoma Society, rebranded Aug 2025) — Therapy Acceleration Program (TAP)
equity_dilution: Strategic venture philanthropy (equity co-investment or return-capped milestone funding directly into early-stage biotech startups)
focus_areas: IND-enabling and Phase 1/2 blood cancer & MPN therapeutics with strong clinical differentiation, including mutant-selective JAK2/CALR and post-JAKi MF.

name: NIH / NCI SBIR & STTR Omnibus & Phase IIB Bridge Awards
typical_award_usd: Phase I: ~$300K-$400K+ | Phase II: ~$2.0M+ | Phase IIB Bridge: up to $4.0M-$4.5M
equity_dilution: 0% (100% non-dilutive federal award for US small businesses; standard deadlines Jan 5, Apr 5, Sept 5)
focus_areas: Small-molecule/degrader discovery, AI digital pathology biomarkers, oncology care-delivery / trial matching software, and 505(b)(2) repurposing.

name: NIH / NHLBI Hematologic Diseases SBIR/STTR & Catalyze Program
typical_award_usd: $300,000 - $2,000,000+ (plus preclinical regulatory/IND support via NHLBI Catalyze)
focus_areas: Bone marrow failure, severe anemia/thrombocytopenia supportive care, JAK2-CHIP clonal hematopoiesis progression, and hematology diagnostics.

name: FDA OOPD — Orphan Products Clinical Trials & Natural History Grants
equity_dilution: 0% (Non-dilutive grant open to for-profit biotechs and academic centers)
focus_areas: Phase 1-3 rare-disease clinical trials and prospective natural-history/RWE registries establishing composite regulatory endpoints in Myelofibrosis.

name: Harrington Discovery Institute — Rare Disease Scholar & Translational Support
equity_dilution: Non-dilutive grant phase with optional mission-aligned impact investment follow-on
focus_areas: Translating academic rare-disease discoveries through hit-to-lead and IND readiness.

name: ARPA-H (ADAPT, SURPASS & Mission Office Open ISO / SBIR)
equity_dilution: 0% (Non-dilutive milestone-driven contracts open to startups without prior NIH grant history)
focus_areas: Adaptive cancer resistance tracking (ADAPT), AI-augmented decentralized trials, in-vivo HSC delivery, and computational drug repurposing.

name: Castleman Disease Collaborative Network (CDCN) & Every Cure Repurposing Collaborations
typical_award_usd: $50,000 - $300,000+ (plus biobank/ACCELERATE registry access & clinical trial co-design)
focus_areas: iMCD-TAFRO biomarker stratification, siltuximab-refractory drug repurposing (JAK/mTOR/cytokine pathways), and AI lymph-node/marrow diagnostics.

name: UPenn Orphan Disease Center — Million Dollar Bike Ride (MDBR) Pilot Grants (VEXAS, Castleman, TBD & Mast Cell Tracks)
equity_dilution: 0% (Non-dilutive; frequently co-funded with Team Telomere, VEXAS Foundation, and CDCN)
focus_areas: Seed proof-of-concept therapeutics, natural-history biomarkers, and computational repurposing across rare hematologic & autoinflammatory diseases.
